name: Tourmaline Crab (Figurine of Wondrous Power)
body:
Aura Moderate transmutation; CL 9th; Craft Wondrous Item, Spells animate objects, water breathing.

DESCRIPTION

This clear reddish gem has the shape of a crab. When activated, the figurine transforms into a giant red crab with a hardness of 8. Both mount and combatant, it grants you the benefit of the water breathing spell while riding on top of it. The giant crab can be summoned 1/day for up to 2 hours.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Spells animate objects; Cost 6,250 gp
